author: Sr_Lycaon
quote: I’ll be direct: the game does what it’s supposed to do, but it falls short in every single aspect. On top of that, it launched with plenty of bugs. I know a lot of people were looking forward to it, but between the lackluster physical edition and the fact that the included codes can be stolen so easily it’s clear how little care the company actually put into this game. Let’s just say that if you’re expecting an epic experience, you won’t find it here; it’s just another run of the mill GTA style game.

author: Sr_Lycaon
quote: It’s a remake of one of the greatest games of all time. With its gameplay enhancements and technical and graphical upgrades, it looks absolutely beautiful—especially for the Nintendo Switch 2. If you ever get the chance to try it, definitely do so; you’re bound to love its world, its story, and its unforgettable characters.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: Sr_Lycaon
quote: It’s the best Splatoon game Nintendo has released; it breathes new life into the series. I just hope certain features carry over to future installments—like the clothing without stat boosts.
